approval_owner: root coordinator under user-approved bounded trial scope
basis: User pointed to updated planning/model-selection guidance. The coordinator settles eight case contracts and evidence boundaries; bounded harness implementation uses Terra/medium. No model is selected merely because this is a recovery task or because the planner is Sol. R1 was unlaunched; no live collection ownership changes.

roles.escalation: Report unsettled case contract or evidence ambiguity to coordinator; do not invent a native guarantee or change model based on subsystem label or failure count

roles.basis: Fixed experimental subjects carried from prior supervised feasibility; this is an experiment configuration, not a builder default

scope: Only private outer-skill trial artifacts and freshly created subject sessions; no Rust, shared source edits, commits, deployment or user-root compaction
